how: 466 questions in three difficulty levels with unambiguous ground-truth answers; scoring is exact match, which keeps evaluation objective.
name: GAIA
note: Humans score about 92 percent; the human-model gap here is a cleaner read on practical agency than most leaderboards.
measures: General assistant competence: questions that are conceptually simple for humans but require browsing, tool use, file handling, and multi-step verification to answer correctly.
maintainer: Mialon et al. (Meta AI, Hugging Face, AutoGPT)
not_measured: Coding depth or specialist domain skill; answers are short and exact-match, so partial competence earns nothing.
